ingredients.name: apples, divided (2 cups chopped into chunks, 2 cups sliced)

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Mix 1 1/4 cups of sugar, 1/4 cup of oil and 2 eggs in a large bowl.
Beat the sugar mixture well.
Combine 2 cups flour and 1 teaspoon each of salt, cinnamon and baking soda in a bowl.
Add the flour mixture to the egg batter and mix well.
Stir 2 cups of apple chunks and 1/4 cup of applesauce into the batter.
Coat an 8 by 8 inch baking pan with vegetable oil spray.
Pour the batter into the pan.
Bake for 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 1 hour.

steps.instruction: Place 2 cups of apple slices on top of the cake and serve.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Add 1 cup of flour, 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda to a bowl.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon, 1/2 cup of packed brown sugar and 1 cup of oats.
Stir the dry ingredients together.
Add 1/2 cup of margarine and cut it into crumbs.
steps.spoken: Add 1/2 cup of margarine or butter. Use 2 table knives to cut it into crumbs.

steps.instruction: Grease the bottom and sides of the baking dish with cooking spray.
Spread half of the crumb mixture in the greased dish.
Core and slice 4 medium apples.
Put the apple slices in the baking dish.
Top the apples with the rest of the crumb mixture.
Bake for 40 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 40 to forty-five minutes.

steps.instruction: Cut into squares to make 24 bars.
steps.spoken: Cut into squares to make 24 bars. The bars will fall apart easily.

ingredients.name: ripe mangos, peeled, pitted and diced

steps.instruction: Peel, pit and dice 2 ripe mangos.
Chop 1 1/2 cups of roasted chicken breast.
Slice 2 green onions and chop 1/2 red bell pepper.
Chop 2 tablespoons of basil and grate 2 medium carrots.
Shred 1 1/2 cups of Savoy or Napa cabbage.
Place the mango, chicken and vegetables in a mixing bowl and toss until well mixed.
Whisk 1/3 cup of cream cheese and 3 tablespoons of peanut butter in a small bowl.
Whisk in 2 teaspoons of soy sauce.
Lay out 4 tortillas and spread 1/4 of the cream cheese mixture on each.
Top each tortilla with the mango, vegetable and chicken mix.
Roll up each tortilla tightly, tucking in the ends, and secure with toothpicks.
Cut each wrap in half.
steps.spoken: Cut each wrap in half. If you are not serving them right away, refrigerate them. They keep well overnight.

ingredients.name: ripe avocado, halved, pitted, peeled and mashed
red or yellow bell pepper, seeded and diced

steps.instruction: Mash 1 peeled, pitted avocado and 1/2 cup of black beans in a bowl with a fork.
Stir in 1/2 tablespoon of cumin, 1 teaspoon of garlic powder and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Spread about 2 tablespoons of the mixture onto each of 10 corn tortillas.
Roll each tortilla tightly to make 10 taquitos.
Heat the air fryer to 400 °F.
Place the taquitos in the air fryer for 5 minutes.
Flip the taquitos and air fry them for 5 more minutes.
steps.spoken: Flip the taquitos and air fry them for 5 more minutes. Some air fryers need only 3 to four minutes per side.

steps.instruction: Mix 1 cup of chopped cherry tomatoes and 1/2 cup of diced bell pepper in a small bowl.
Mix in 1 tablespoon of jalapeño, 1 tablespoon of onion and 2 tablespoons of cilantro.
Mix in 1 tablespoon of lime juice to make fresh pico de gallo.
Remove the taquitos from the air fryer when they are golden brown and crispy.
Top the taquitos with the pico de gallo and 1/2 cup of Greek yogurt.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Add 1 box of mostaccioli or penne rigate to the boiling water.
steps.spoken: Add 1 box of mostaccioli or penne rigate to the boiling water. Add the pasta to the boiling water and cook for 6 minutes. It should be very firm, not soft.

steps.instruction: Drain the pasta.
Put the pasta in a baking dish.
Add 1 jar (24 ounces) of fra diavolo sauce and mix well.
Cover the pasta with 8 ounces of shredded mozzarella.
steps.spoken: Cover the pasta with 8 ounces of shredded mozzarella. Cover the pasta and sauce generously with the cheese, until you can't see the pasta.

steps.instruction: Bake in the oven at 350 °F for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake in the oven at 350 °F for 20 minutes.

ingredients.name: blueberries or strawberries, fresh or frozen

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Spray a 12-cup muffin pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Mix 1/4 cup of applesauce, 1/4 cup of sugar and 2 tablespoons of dried egg mix.
steps.spoken: Mix 1/4 cup of applesauce, 1/4 cup of sugar and 2 tablespoons of dried egg mix, or 1 egg, in a medium bowl.

steps.instruction: Mix in 2 mashed ripe bananas and 2 tablespoons of water until well mixed.
Mix 1/4 cup of all-purpose flour and 1/4 cup of whole wheat flour in a large bowl.
Mix in 1/4 cup of quick cooking oats.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon each of baking powder and baking soda and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Add the applesauce mixture to the dry ingredients and mix just until moist.
Gently add 1/4 cup of blueberries or strawberries to the mixture.
Fill each muffin cup about 3/4 full of batter.
Bake for 25 minutes, until lightly brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 25 to thirty minutes, until the muffins are lightly brown.

steps.instruction: Cool the muffins for 10 minutes, then remove them from the pan.
Heat 1 1/2 cups of vegetable stock until nearly boiling, then keep it hot.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a heavy, medium saucepan.
Add 1/2 large diced onion and a generous pinch of salt.
Cook until the onion is soft and transparent.
Add 1 cup of arborio rice and stir until each grain is coated.
Add 1/2 cup of beer and heat to a simmer, stirring constantly.
When the beer is mostly absorbed, add 1/3 to 1/2 cup of hot stock.
steps.spoken: When the beer is mostly absorbed, add 1/3 to a half cup of hot stock. Stir constantly while simmering. Repeat for around 20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Keep adding hot stock a little at a time until most of it is used up.
Take the pan off the heat.
Stir in 1/4 cup of grated Parmesan cheese until it melts.
Stir in 1/4 cup of shredded sharp cheddar cheese until it melts.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1/4 cup of shredded sharp cheddar cheese until it melts. For a cheesier risotto, add more cheese.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Dice 24 ounces of raw chicken breast.
Cook the chicken in a pan with oil until no pink is left.
Cook 16 ounces of macaroni in boiling water for 7 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cook 16 ounces of macaroni in boiling water for 7 minutes. Cook the macaroni for a few minutes less than usual, about 7 to eight minutes.

steps.instruction: Add the chicken and the pasta to a casserole dish.
Mix the chicken and pasta together.
Mix in 16 ounces of diced tomatoes and 9 ounces of shredded mozzarella cheese.
Top with 1 1/2 ounces of parmesan cheese and 1 1/2 ounces of bread crumbs.
steps.spoken: Top with 1 1/2 ounces of parmesan cheese and 1 1/2 ounces of bread crumbs. Top with the parmesan cheese and bread crumbs, for an even coat. Add more mozzarella and parmesan if you like a lot of cheese.

steps.instruction: Dot the top evenly with 1 tablespoon of butter.
Bake for 22 minutes, until the top looks golden.
steps.spoken: Bake for 22 to twenty-five minutes, until the top looks golden.

source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Deliciously Healthy Family Meals

ingredients.name: cooked mixed vegetables, or 1/2 bag frozen stir-fry vegetable mix

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of garlic, 1 teaspoon of ginger and 1 tablespoon of scallions.
steps.spoken: Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 cup of sliced water chestnuts.
steps.spoken: Add 1/2 cup of sliced water chestnuts. Keep cooking for 1 to two minutes, until the water chestnuts begin to soften.

steps.instruction: Add 2 cups of mixed vegetables.
steps.spoken: Toss for 2 to three minutes, or up to five minutes for frozen vegetables, until heated through.

steps.instruction: Add 2 cups of cooked brown rice.
steps.spoken: Add 2 cups of cooked brown rice. Keep cooking for 3 to five minutes, until the rice is hot.

steps.instruction: Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1 teaspoon of sesame oil.
Toss well and serve.

ingredients.name: frozen mango juice, or 1 fresh pitted mango

steps.instruction: Put 2 cups of milk and 4 tablespoons of frozen mango juice in a blender.
steps.spoken: Put 2 cups of low-fat milk and 4 tablespoons of frozen mango juice in a blender. You can use 1 fresh pitted mango instead of the juice.

steps.instruction: Add 1 small banana and 2 ice cubes.
Blend until foamy.
Serve immediately.

ingredients.name: yucca, peeled and cut into 3-inch sections

steps.instruction: Put 1 pound of yucca in a pot with cold water to cover it by 1 inch.
Bring the water to a boil.
Simmer the yucca slowly for 20 minutes, until it is tender.
steps.spoken: Simmer the yucca slowly for 20 to thirty minutes, until it is tender.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Lift the yucca out with a slotted spoon onto a cutting board to cool.
Cut the yucca lengthwise into 3/4-inch wedges, and discard the woody core.
Spray a baking sheet lightly with cooking spray.
Spread the wedges in one layer and spray them with cooking spray.
Cover with foil and bake for 8 minutes.
Uncover the yucca and bake 7 more minutes.

ingredients.name: potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-size chunks

steps.instruction: Place 5 potatoes in a pot and just cover them with water.
steps.spoken: Place the 5 peeled potatoes, cut into bite-size chunks, in a pot and just cover them with water.

steps.instruction: Partly cover the pot and bring it to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer, partly covered, for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Simmer, partly covered, for 5 minutes, just until the potatoes are tender. Don't overcook them.

steps.instruction: Drain the potatoes well.
Stir 1 cup of plain yogurt with 1/2 cup of mayonnaise in a large bowl.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of horseradish, salt and pepper.
Stir in 4 sliced radishes and 2 stalks of diced celery.
Stir in 2 sliced green onions, 1/4 cup of parsley and 1/4 cup of dill.
Add the warm potatoes and stir to combine.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Then taste and adjust the seasonings if you like.

ingredients.name: dried parsley or herbs de Provence

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375 °F.
Cook 1 1/2 pounds of potatoes in a large pot of salted water for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cook 1 1/2 pounds of potatoes in a large pot of salted water for 20 minutes. Cook the potatoes in a large pot of salted water for 20 to thirty minutes, until they are tender.

steps.instruction: Drain the potatoes.
Add 2 tablespoons of butter and 1/2 cup of milk to the potatoes.
Add 1 teaspoon of dried parsley or herbs de Provence and a pinch of nutmeg.
Mash the potatoes with a masher or an electric mixer.
Brown 1 diced onion in 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 pound of ground beef and cook until golden brown.
Add 1 tablespoon of herbs de Provence and 1 teaspoon of Worcestershire sauce.
Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and cook for 2 more minutes.
Set the beef aside.
Press the beef into the bottom of a 6 to 8-inch baking dish.
Cover the beef evenly with 1 small can of whole kernel corn.
Cover that with 1 small can of cream style corn.
Finish with a layer of the mashed potatoes.
Sprinkle paprika on top, to taste.
Bake for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 20 to thirty minutes.

steps.instruction: If you like, finish under the broiler for no more than 2 minutes.
